title: Refund took a week
body: My refund for a torn jacket arrived after 6 working days. Support were quick to reply by email.

title: Exchanging boots for a bigger size
body: Return the boots unworn within 30 days and order the new size; the refund comes back once the return arrives.

title: Express delivery cut-off
body: Orders before 2pm went out the same day for me, arrived next morning.
